text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as we finished that day's training
and were about to wrap things up...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah...
...All right, that one felt really good!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: My "Pegasus Mach Strike" can evolve way, way further!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run one more time before I forget this feeling!
And I'll become stronger than I was yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmmph...! That Biko!
Doing special training is so cheeky, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan can't lose to some hero! I'm gonna train even harder!
choice_data_list: Let's sit back and watch from above.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just watch!
I'm gonna shut them up good!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Through special training,
I'll evolve my special move to be even flashier, I say!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Biko!
I'm definitely not gonna lose to you of all people, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy kept up what she called "special training" until she was fully satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Watching from on high... feels super Demon King-like!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I know! It might be nice to snack on sweets
while watching that guy's special training, after all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahaha! Such is the composure of the Demon King!
Do your best to try and keep up, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Shinko Windy happily
watched Biko Pegasus's special training.
